title: Replication archive for: News-Based Corridor Disruption and Producer-Terminal Price Transmission in Kashmir's Apple Sector: A NASCDI-NARDL Analysis
description:
Code, inputs and results for the revised analysis of producer-to-terminal apple price transmission in Kashmir using a weekly news-based corridor-disruption index (NASCDI) built from GDELT Global Knowledge Graph metadata, and nonlinear ARDL (NARDL) models with finite-sample bounds tests and wild-bootstrap inference.

What changed in this version. The first GDELT extract was incomplete after February 2018; all months were re-exported and the index rebuilt. Every result of the revised paper uses the rebuilt index.

Contents. data/nascdi_news_v2/: rebuilt daily and weekly NASCDI. data/model_news_v2/: weekly chain files (prices, index, partial sums). data/clean/prices_long.csv: cleaned daily prices from the Aglar (Shopian), Nowpora (Sopore) and Azadpur APMC paper registers, including values filled during preparation. src/rebuild_v2/ and results_rebuild_v2/: scripts and outputs behind the tables and figures. config/lexicon_news.yaml: the 213-term lexicon. See README.md.

Superseded material. src/revision/ and results_revision/ (earlier round on the incomplete extract; only the prices-only outputs remain valid), src/models/, results/, data/model/ and data/nascdi_news/.

Not included. The article-level scored corpus and the raw GDELT exports; the exports can be recreated with src/news/export_gdelt_gkg_bigquery.py.
